integrity.mathematical_basis: Exact Fourier and finite-difference proof, trigonometric cubic integration, positive Poisson convolution, plus a runnable independent-computation checker.
integrity.unproved_limits: No global classification of all homometric convex bodies; no stability estimates; no independent audit.

scientific_limitations: The minimal-side rigidity is restricted to equilateral centrally symmetric planar polygons; the third-width-moment distinction is for the exhibited octagons. Analytic smooth examples are planar. No noisy-measurement stability or independent historical-priority certification is asserted.
title: A sharp eight-side obstruction to recovering planar shapes from rotational width correlations
